title: The snapshot matches the log position only while nothing writes

found.by: zerobus-debezium-test every source but crdb and yb

symptom: (design) T is read while the source is quiet
cause: These sources can't read a snapshot as of a given log position the way the test needs
effect: With live writes, rows changed between T and the snapshot read are applied twice or missed
fix: Tie the snapshot to the log position: PostgreSQL's exported slot snapshot, SQL Server or Oracle snapshot isolation or flashback; or let Debezium snapshot
